entries.title: Job 21:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said:

entries.title: Job 21:2
segments: "Listen carefully to my speech, And let this be your consolation.

entries.title: Job 21:3
segments: Bear with me that I may speak, And after I have spoken, keep mocking.

entries.title: Job 21:4
segments: "As for me, [is] my complaint against man? And if [it were], why should I not be impatient?

entries.title: Job 21:5
segments: Look at me and be astonished; Put [your] hand over [your] mouth.

entries.title: Job 21:6
segments: Even when I remember I am terrified, And trembling takes hold of my flesh.

entries.title: Job 21:7
segments: ¶Why do the wicked live [and] become old, Yes, become mighty in power?

entries.title: Job 21:8
segments: Their descendants are established with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes.

entries.title: Job 21:9
segments: Their houses [are] safe from fear, Neither [is] the rod of God upon them.

entries.title: Job 21:10
segments: Their bull breeds without failure; Their cow calves without miscarriage.

entries.title: Job 21:11
segments: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.

entries.title: Job 21:12
segments: They sing to the tambourine and harp, And rejoice to the sound of the flute.

entries.title: Job 21:13
segments: They spend their days in wealth, And in a moment go down to the grave.

entries.title: Job 21:14
segments: Yet they say to God, 'Depart from us, For we do not desire the knowledge of Your ways.

entries.title: Job 21:15
segments: Who [is] the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit do we have if we pray to Him?'

entries.title: Job 21:16
segments: Indeed their prosperity [is] not in their hand; The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 21:17
segments: ¶"How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? [How often] does their destruction come upon them, The sorrows [God] distributes in His anger?

entries.title: Job 21:18
segments: They are like straw before the wind, And like chaff that a storm carries away.

entries.title: Job 21:19
segments: [They say], 'God lays up one's iniquity for his children'; Let Him recompense him, that he may know [it].

entries.title: Job 21:20
segments: Let his eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 21:21
segments: For what does he care about his household after him, When the number of his months is cut in half?

entries.title: Job 21:22
segments: "Can [anyone] teach God knowledge, Since He judges those on high?

entries.title: Job 21:23
segments: One dies in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and secure;

entries.title: Job 21:24
segments: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moist.

entries.title: Job 21:25
segments: Another man dies in the bitterness of his soul, Never having eaten with pleasure.

entries.title: Job 21:26
segments: They lie down alike in the dust, And worms cover them.

entries.title: Job 21:27
segments: ¶"Look, I know your thoughts, And the schemes [with which] you would wrong me.

entries.title: Job 21:28
segments: For you say, 'Where [is] the house of the prince? And where [is] the tent, The dwelling place of the wicked?'

entries.title: Job 21:29
segments: Have you not asked those who travel the road? And do you not know their signs?

entries.title: Job 21:30
segments: For the wicked are reserved for the day of doom; They shall be brought out on the day of wrath.

entries.title: Job 21:31
segments: Who condemns his way to his face? And who repays him [for what] he has done?

entries.title: Job 21:32
segments: Yet he shall be brought to the grave, And a vigil kept over the tomb.

entries.title: Job 21:33
segments: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him; Everyone shall follow him, As countless [have gone] before him.

entries.title: Job 21:34
segments: How then can you comfort me with empty words, Since falsehood remains in your answers?"
